senses.sense_definition: Of great size, extent, or importance; imposing.

target_lang_translations.cs: <w>Mohutná</w> řeka protéká třemi různými zeměmi, než dosáhne moře.
target_lang_translations.tr: <w>Muazzam</w> nehir, denize ulaşmadan önce üç farklı ülkeden geçer.

target_lang_translations.zh: 伐木工挥动斧头，用<w>强劲</w>的一击劈开了圆木。

target_lang_translations.ru: <w>Мощным</w> прыжком тигр перепрыгнул через широкий ручей.

examples.text: That was a <w>mighty</w> meal you cooked for us last night.

target_lang_translations.zh: 你昨晚为我们做的饭菜真是<w>极好</w>。

examples.text: It is a <w>mighty</w> pleasure to finally meet you in person.

examples.text: It is getting <w>mighty</w> cold outside, so you should wear a coat.
